official_references.title: Microsoft Azure Architecture Center: Strangler Fig pattern
official_references.read_scope: Context/solution, temporary facade cost, shared resources, performance and cross-system dependency considerations; not Azure deployment instructions.
official_references.used_for: Choose gradual replacement when interception and coexistence fit; budget adapter/transition cost instead of prescribing a pattern universally.

official_references.title: AWS Prescriptive Guidance: Transactional outbox pattern
official_references.read_scope: Intent, failure cases, duplicate/order considerations and transactional outbox/CDC explanation; linked code and AWS deployment not executed.
official_references.used_for: Distinguish same-transaction updates from cross-system dual writes; preserve idempotency and ordering without claiming automatic end-to-end exactly-once.

official_references.title: Kubernetes: CronJob
official_references.read_scope: Concurrency policy, suspension, deadlines, time zones, modification and job-creation limitations; no cluster used.
official_references.used_for: A scheduler may miss or duplicate runs; policy for one CronJob does not prevent another scheduler from executing the same business job; existing jobs continue after suspension.

official_references.title: PostgreSQL 18: Logical replication restrictions
official_references.read_scope: Current page identified as PostgreSQL 18; DDL/schema, sequences, relation/large-object limitations; no database used.
official_references.used_for: Do not assume row replication also transfers schema, sequences and all related assets; verify actual engine/tool/version.

official_references.title: Prisma: Expand-and-contract migrations
